note: Provenance of the roster-<slug>.html, stats-<slug>.json, game-stats-<slug>.json and box-<slug>-<contest id>.json captures. The fifteen SCVAL teams were captured 2026-10-02; a deliberate sample of the other three leagues 2026-10-03. Every roster page is trimmed the same way (see the comment at the top of each file); each stats file is the rollup response as served.

rosters.greenfield: PCAL, sparse: names, a jersey for half
rosters.stevenson: PCAL, full fields and a soft-deleted row

stats.berkeley: MCAL, the 400 no-data envelope, a team with a roster
stats.del-mar: BVAL, the 400 no-data envelope, a team with no roster
stats.monterey: PCAL, the 400 no-data envelope, a team with no roster

teams.homestead: SCVAL, the per-game team totals (team-season-game-stats rollup) as served: four goals on Lynbrook and Los Altos, none on the three games its notes name
teams.palo-alto: SCVAL, the per-game team totals as served 2026-10-24T20:35Z, every row a game the coach entered: the box-palo-alto captures are three of its finals, and its other finals have no capture, so are not read offline

files.box-palo-alto-47015ab4-f9d2-4366-a8f6-cd: SCVAL, Palo Alto's box score for its 0-4 loss at Los Gatos, as served
files.box-palo-alto-80175ec7-ea39-42d1-a0ab-39: SCVAL, Palo Alto's box score for its 3-0 win at Santa Clara, as served
